# Classification vectors for user data unregistered SEI payloads (ADR-0210).
# Replayed by ffmpeg-patches/test/udu_wrap_test.c against
# ffmpeg-patches/files/pelorus_udu_wrap.h; the vmafx reader replays the same
# file, so both readers are proven against one set.
#
# One vector per line: name outer_uuid_hex data_hex expected
#   outer_uuid_hex  the 16-byte uuid_iso_iec_11578 of the SEI message
#   data_hex        the bytes after it; "-" means no bytes (length 0)
#   expected        direct | x265_wrapped | none
# x265 UUID 2ca2de09-b517-47db-bb55-a4fe7fc2fc4e is the one libx265 writes in
# front of every caller payload (since x265 2.1).
